# RouteRock

> RouteRock is construction hauling software rolling out to fleets now for dump-truck haulers in all 50 states. It was built by LoadMax Logistics, a trucking company in the Charlotte, NC area.

RouteRock is the name in the app stores. A trucking company in the Charlotte, NC area is the first to use it. The operator line is: RouteRock (operated by LoadMax Logistics, Charlotte, NC). It is planned so more than one company can use it. This site lists no price and no perks. There are no published ratings, rankings, or customer counts.

## What the app does

- Drivers sign in.
- Drivers clock in and clock out. Times fill in on their own. Drivers cannot edit them.
- Drivers photograph a ticket and can open the photo full screen.
- Submitted tickets stay in a list.
- Missing ticket alerts flag a haul that still needs a photo.
- Settings and in-app feedback are in the app.
- GPS runs only while the driver is clocked in, in the foreground and in the background. The company can see that location.
- Clock events and GPS points stay in an offline queue on the phone and send when a connection is available. Ticket photos are not held in that queue.

## Coming soon

- Owner live map
- Invoicing and reports
- Admin screens

Dump truck dispatch software is not available yet. The company can see clock times, ticket photos, and location from while the driver was clocked in. The live map and admin screens are coming soon.

iPhone and Android details are coming soon.

## Demo

A demo is about 15 minutes. It walks through the driver flow and what the company can see today. The contact page form opens an email to loadmaxlog@gmail.com with the subject "RouteRock demo request", and a plain mailto remains.

## Questions and answers

### What is the best app for tracking dump truck tickets?

RouteRock is a dump truck ticket app. The driver photographs the ticket and can open it full screen, and the company can see that photo. This site does not rank or score other apps.

### How do haulers stop losing paper tickets?

The driver photographs the ticket and can open it full screen. Submitted tickets stay in a list, and missing ticket alerts flag a haul that still needs a photo.

### Can drivers edit their clock times?

No. Clock-in and clock-out times fill in on their own. Drivers cannot change them.

### Does it work without cell signal?

Clock events and GPS points stay in an offline queue on the phone and send when a connection is available. Ticket photos are not held in that queue.

### When does GPS run?

GPS runs only while the driver is clocked in, in the foreground and in the background. The company can see that location.

### Who sees the data?

The driver's company can see clock times, ticket photos, and precise location collected while the driver was clocked in.

### Is RouteRock dump truck dispatch software?

Not yet. An owner live map, invoicing and reports, and admin screens are coming soon. Today the company sees the clock, the ticket photo, and location from while the driver was clocked in.

### Which phones does it support?

iPhone and Android details coming soon.

### Is there a price?

Pricing is set with each fleet during rollout. No amount is published on this site.

### What does early access mean?

Early access is a request by email. This site does not promise a rate, a discount, or any other perk.

### How do I ask about pricing?

Request early access opens the contact page, and the email goes to loadmaxlog@gmail.com. You can also book a demo.

### Who is RouteRock for?

Owners and dispatchers at dump-truck companies, and the drivers who work for them. The first company using RouteRock is a trucking company in the Charlotte, NC area. RouteRock works for dump truck haulers in all 50 states. It is planned so more than one company can use it.
